source_title: Zip Codes (map GR-25682, dated 3/11/2026) | Sacramento County, saccounty.gov
notes: Only the ZIP numbers printed on the county's ZIP code map were taken (61 distinct; 95670, 95683 and 95690 are printed twice). The map shows ZIP areas in and around the county; a ZIP area can cross the county line, so a ZIP here may also include addresses in a neighboring county. Use the county the Supervisor passes when it has one; this list is the fallback for a ZIP-only request. PO-box-only ZIPs (for example 95812) are not on the map and are not listed.
